title: trace eval scorer result
description: One Patcher scorer's verdict on one (bundle_dir, replay invocation) pair. Each scorer reads ONLY the on-disk Patcher outputs (patch.diff / patch-rationale.md / refusal.json) plus the recorded invocation metadata; nothing reaches into in-memory runner state. The schema also describes the per-bundle composite summary that aggregates the five scorers.

scorer_version.description: Semver of the scorer implementation. Bumped when the scoring formula or the data it consumes changes.

applies.description: False when the scorer was structurally inapplicable (e.g. historical-fix-similarity with no historical_fix recorded). When false, score MUST be null and notes MUST explain the reason.

advisory.description: True for scorers whose result is informational only and MUST NOT enter the composite merge-ready denominator (e.g. historical-fix-similarity). Composite computation excludes scorers where advisory==true.

score.description: Higher is better. Range [0,1]. Null iff applies==false.

notes.description: Short explanation of how the score was derived. Required even on score=1.0.

details.description: Optional structured per-scorer breakdown. Schema is scorer-specific.

bundle_dir.description: Display path; informational. Reviewers rely on the invocation_id + replay sha256s for integrity, not on this string.

invocation_id.description: UUID of the replay invocation being scored.

patcher_kind.description: Whether the Patcher invocation produced a patch or a refusal. Refusal-shape Patcher invocations score against a different sub-set of scorers (schema-valid only); the rest report applies==false.

prompt_sha.description: sha256 of the Patcher prompt the invocation ran under. Lifted from invocation.prompt.sha256 by the runner. Aggregators use this to slice runs by prompt revision.

model_id.description: Model identifier the Patcher invocation used. Lifted from invocation.model.model_id. Aggregators use this to slice runs by model.

composite.description: Composite merge-ready signal. Mean of non-advisory scorers where applies==true. Excludes historical-fix-similarity (advisory) and any inapplicable scorers (applies==false).

cohort_class.description: Mirrors patcher_kind so downstream aggregators can tell at a glance which composite-denominator class this report represents (the patch denominator typically has 5 of 6 scorers; the refusal denominator has 2). 'patch' = Patcher emitted a patch; 'refusal' = Patcher refused, the refusal-shape scorers are in the denominator instead.
